{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Wide-leg trousers, high-waisted, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal grey (#3E4147), wool crepe with a soft brushed finish
Fine-knit turtleneck sweater, slightly fitted, hip length, dusty blue (#8FA9C4), merino wool
Straight-cut blazer, single-breasted, mid-hip length, textured herringbone in heather grey (#9A9CA3), wool blend
Long tailored wool coat, straight cut, knee to mid-calf length, deep navy (#232F45), double-faced wool with a soft matte finish
Ankle boots, low block heel about 4 cm, round toe, black (#1C1C1E), smooth leather with a grippy rubber sole
Scarf, large and soft, folded loosely at the neck, ivory (#EDE6DA), cashmere blend
Leather gloves, lined, wrist length, black (#1C1C1E), smooth leather with a fleece lining
Structured tote bag, medium size, shoulder strap, black (#1C1C1E), grained leather

This outfit fits a cold morning walk to the office and still reads as neat business dress once the coat comes off. The dusty blue knit echoes her eyes and sits softly against her light, cool-toned skin and silver hair, while the charcoal and heather grey keep the look calm and professional. The high waist and the straight blazer give a clean, balanced line from shoulder to hem, and the wide leg adds easy movement for walking. The warm wool layers, scarf, gloves and the low block heel with a grippy sole keep her comfortable and steady in frosty weather."}
